Description: Threshold trimmer (0-4.7 V), adjusted through the lid
Red indicator, on while the output is low: set the trimmer so it blinks once per wheel turn
Reverse-polarity protection: a swapped +5V/GND cable can't reach the comparator
Indicator LED feed (~3 mA) and local output pull-up
Comparator input resistor (hysteresis divider with the 390k)
TCRT5000 emitter: (4.7 V - 1.2 V) / 220R = 16 mA (60 mA max)
Output series resistor (cable ESD / short protection)
Positive feedback: ~3.2 V x 10k / 400k = 80 mV hysteresis
Reflective IR sensor (950 nm, peak at 2.5 mm, 0.2-15 mm range) on the back, looking at the metallic half-disc through the dial glass
3-pole 3 mm SMD push-in terminal (0.14-0.34 mm2 solid) to the main unit: 1=+5V, 2=GND, 3=PULSE (IO4)
